notes.en: Public preview 0.2.4. Fixes from real-device feedback. Device Inbox: an outgoing send can now be removed, and a delivery the other device has not saved yet can be cancelled; finished sends leave the Outgoing list on their own. Nearby: the mode that finds the Relayium website and the Mac app now comes first, and it shows your public IP, because devices find each other there only when it matches. Cross-network: a connection that drops while you wait no longer ends the session as "code not active"; the app rejoins the same code, keeps the screen on while your code is waiting, shows a QR for a code you create, and closes the scanner after a successful scan. A brief network interruption on a connected session gets a few seconds to recover instead of ending it. Messages open when you press Send and incoming conversations are accepted automatically, as on the website, and the app says up front when no relay is available. Everything still runs while the app is open, with no background transfer. Direct APK only, not on Google Play, and it contains no Play Services and no Play Billing.
notes.zh: 公开预览版 0.2.4。根据真机反馈修复。设备收件箱：发送项现在可以移除，对方尚未保存的投递可以取消；已完成的发送会自动离开“发送中”列表。附近设备：能找到 Relayium 网页版和 Mac 应用的模式现在排在第一位，并显示你的公网 IP——只有两边的公网 IP 相同，设备才能在那里互相发现。跨网络：等待对方时连接断开，不再以“配对码无效”结束会话，应用会用同一个配对码重新连接；等待期间保持屏幕常亮；创建的配对码会显示二维码；扫码成功后扫码界面自动关闭。已连接的会话遇到短暂网络中断时，会给几秒钟恢复而不是直接结束。按“发送”即可开始消息对话，收到的对话请求会像网页版一样自动接受；没有可用中继时会提前说明。所有功能仍然只在应用打开时运行，没有后台传输。仅以 APK 直接分发，不在 Google Play 上架，不含 Play 服务与 Play 结算。
